title: S5 Clash and Coordination Check Types

entries.name: Level 1 Hard Clash
entries.criterion: Solid geometric intersection above the project-defined tolerance.
entries.tolerance: Project BEP/ruleset in millimeters; no enterprise numeric default.

entries.name: Level 2 Soft Clash / Clearance
entries.criterion: Encroachment into governed access, maintenance, egress, travel, or deflection envelope.

entries.name: Level 3 QA / Data Integrity
entries.criterion: Missing mandatory data, non-compliant naming, or model completeness failure.
entries.tolerance: Zero tolerance for mandatory governed fields at the applicable gate.

entries.name: Governed Exclusion / Ignore Set
entries.criterion: Known non-issues suppressed by approved search/selection logic.

entries.name: Duplicate Geometry
entries.criterion: Coincident identical elements or duplicate authored instances.

tolerance_policy: Enterprise S5 defines tolerance governance but not project numeric values. Numeric clash tolerances are project/BEP data and shall be recorded in millimeters.

provenance.migration_note: Leading non-JSON comment from extraction was not carried into repository content.
